description:
Create a new campaign 'SEN_WEST' by cloning the existing 'SENPOLL' campaign. 

Goal: The new campaign must inherit all the complex tuning parameters (Dial Method, Timeout, Drop limits, etc.) from 'SENPOLL', but must have the following specific changes:
- Campaign ID: SEN_WEST
- Campaign Name: Senate Polling West
- Active: Y
- Campaign CallerID: 3105550199
- Manual Dial Prefix: 9

Starting State: Login to Vicidial Admin (User: 6666, Pass: andromeda). Navigate to Campaigns. Use the 'Copy Campaign' feature to clone 'SENPOLL' to 'SEN_WEST', then modify the specific fields listed above. Do not change other technical settings.
